request.requirement: FUR +15 settings must not overtake ICON combat performance.

diagnosis: ICON fixed collection power 180,000 was below current FUR +15 power 195,200 (Faker 198,200).
Several battle adapters copied uniqueAbility/uniqueAdvancement but omitted the authoritative iconRole, disabling RPG passives and skills.

policy.scope: Recognized, enabled ICON role cards only; same equipment and external buff conditions.
policy.floor: Each of attack, defense, maximum HP and speed is at least 1.2 times the highest FUR +15 benchmark for that stat, including eligible advancement. Current catalogue and CMS growth settings are read for each ICON battle.
policy.deck: Two ICONs allowed per five-card deck; third blocked by client, saves, old snapshots, matchmaking and common battle preparation.
policy.captain: Legacy Captain duels retain their existing combat model and use attack/HP/defense/speed floors; seven RPG skill timelines apply in the V3 engine, not the old Captain duel renderer.
preserved: Collection base power 180,000 and approved photo/SD art
Existing FUR growth and unique-effect multipliers
ICON fusion enabled=false, currency costs and rewards
Skill cooldown, activation, damage, heal and protection budgets
Historical battle receipts and replay snapshots

verification.method: Fixed seeds; PVP sides reversed; all 20 current FURs and four maximum-growth archetypes; two-card combinations against elite FUR pairs with equal common teammates and zero / 5,000,000 equipment bonus.
verification.limit: Measured advantage and a starting-stat floor, not forced victory against any opponent, gear, magic, team composition or random seed.
verification.browser: Real player shell and start buttons on 1440px PVP and 390px PVE; picker 2 accepted / 3 rejected; role details; server ICON event counts exactly match playback; result and return verified; no page errors.

release.reason: ICON-only stat floor, omitted role propagation and two-card contract. No authentication, schema, transactions, reward, dependency or combat mechanics rewrite. Affected combat and deck regressions plus live loader are selected.
